title: Amprius Sets June 2026 Events Schedule
summary: Amprius Technologies, Inc., a leader in silicon anode lithium-ion batteries, today announced its schedule for June appearances and activities.
body_markdown:
**FREMONT, Calif. – June 1, 2026** –[Amprius Technologies, Inc.](https://amprius.com/) **(“Amprius” or the “Company”) (NYSE: AMPX)** , a leader in silicon anode lithium-ion batteries, today announced its schedule for June appearances and activities.


[Eurosatory](https://www.eurosatory.com/en/)


Date: June 15-19, 2026


Location: Paris-Nord Villepinte Exhibition Centre in Villepinte; Paris, France


Event Details: Amprius will exhibit at booth CD224. Members of the Amprius Management and Business Development teams are available for one-on-one meetings. If you are interested in scheduling a meeting with the business development team, please contactsales@amprius.com .


**[Amprius Hosted Webinar](https://event.on24.com/wcc/r/5340400/93B88F8DEDD1CEF0B4C7A7560793C808)**


Date: June 17, 2026


Location: Virtual


Event Details: Amprius CTO Dr. Ionel Stefan will host a webinar focused on the evolving power demands of UAV operations and how silicon-anode battery technology is enabling longer-duration flights, heavier payloads, and improved operational efficiency. The webinar will cover battery performance considerations for high-altitude and long-duration missions, defense electrification applications, NDAA compliance considerations, and practical integration pathways for next-generation energy solutions across UAV and tactical defense platforms. Featured speakers include Ionel Stefan, CTO of Amprius, Pete Bitar, Co-Founder and Director of Flight Systems at Leo Flight, and Trent Clawson, President and Chief Engineer at Titan Batteries. If you are interested in attending the webinar, please register through[Amprius’ event page](https://event.on24.com/wcc/r/5340400/93B88F8DEDD1CEF0B4C7A7560793C808) .


[Automate](https://www.automateshow.com/?utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=branded_show&utm_term=automate%202026&utm_campaign=Branded+Show&utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&hsa_acc=4764274990&hsa_cam=15694983575&hsa_grp=130801408319&hsa_ad=788545517454&hsa_src=g&hsa_tgt=kwd-2417015215640&hsa_kw=automate%202026&hsa_mt=e&hsa_net=adwords&hsa_ver=3&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=15694983575&gbraid=0AAAAAoWdwfccuZUX6QuUXVss51LZ7l7wh&gclid=Cj0KCQjwz9_QBhD_ARIsADnSCfB52gcQ2Amblm8YDf6lry4DWP8Gaoi_eN359qorsN9I4qT-VmH-LOQaAtSkEALw_wcB)


Date: June 22-25, 2026


Location: McCormick Place; Chicago, IL


Event Details: Amprius will exhibit at booth 36017. Members of the Amprius Management and Business Development teams are available for one-on-one meetings. If you are interested in scheduling a meeting with the business development team, please contactsales@amprius.com . If you are an investor attending the event and interested in connecting with management, please contactir@amprius.com .


**About Amprius Technologies, Inc.**
Amprius Technologies, Inc. is a leader in advanced lithium-ion battery technology, delivering high-energy and high-power silicon-anode batteries with up to twice the energy density, range, and flight time of conventional graphite-based cells. Headquartered in Fremont, California, Amprius operates an R&D lab and pilot manufacturing facility for silicon anodes and cells. To support scalable production, the Company employs a contract manufacturing strategy, enabling rapid capacity expansion with minimal capital investment. Committed to driving innovation in energy storage, Amprius powers next-generation applications in aerospace, defense, and mobility. For additional information, please visit[amprius.com](https://amprius.com/) and the Company’s[LinkedIn page](https://www.linkedin.com/company/ampriustechnologies/posts/?feedView=all) .
